testcases.title: Verify customer ID is system generated and unique
testcases.objective: Verify that the system generates a unique customer ID when a valid customer is created.
steps: Create a valid customer without supplying customerId.
Create another valid customer with different customer data.
expected_result: Customer IDs are generated by the system.

testcases.title: Verify customer name is mandatory
testcases.objective: Verify that customer creation fails when customerName is missing or empty.
steps: Submit a create request without customerName.
Submit a create request with an empty customerName.

testcases.title: Verify country is mandatory
testcases.objective: Verify that customer creation fails when country is missing.
steps: Submit a valid customer request without country.

testcases.title: Verify only supported countries are accepted
testcases.objective: Verify supported countries are accepted and unsupported countries are rejected.
steps: Submit requests using India, Germany, UK and USA.
Submit a request using an unsupported country.
expected_result: Invalid request does not create or modify customer data.

testcases.title: Verify country validation is case insensitive
testcases.objective: Verify supported country names are accepted regardless of case.
steps: Submit supported countries using different case combinations.
expected_result: Valid country values are accepted irrespective of case.

testcases.title: Verify optional email validation
testcases.objective: Verify email may be omitted but must be valid when supplied.
expected_result: Invalid email does not create or modify data.

testcases.title: Verify optional phone validation
testcases.objective: Verify phone may be omitted but must be valid when supplied.
expected_result: Invalid phone does not modify data.

testcases.title: Create customer using valid authorized request
testcases.objective: Verify an authorized user can create a valid customer.

testcases.title: Reject duplicate customer creation
testcases.objective: Verify duplicate customer creation is rejected.
preconditions: An existing customer with the same customerName and country exists.
steps: Create or identify an existing customer.
Submit another create request with the same customerName and country.

testcases.title: Verify exactly one record is created
testcases.objective: Verify one valid create request produces exactly one customer record.
preconditions: Valid unique customer data is available.

testcases.title: Verify created customer can be retrieved
testcases.objective: Verify successful creation is confirmed through subsequent retrieval.
steps: Compare retrieved information with create request.
expected_result: Retrieved customer data matches expected values.

testcases.title: Verify duplicate creation returns conflict
testcases.objective: Verify duplicate creation produces an appropriate conflict response.

testcases.title: Verify duplicate definition uses customer name and country
testcases.objective: Verify duplicate detection is based on customerName and country combination.
steps: Attempt same customerName with different country.
Attempt different customerName with same country.
expected_result: Same name and country is treated as duplicate.
Different country is not incorrectly treated as duplicate.
Different customer name is not incorrectly treated as duplicate.

testcases.title: Verify existing customer remains unchanged after duplicate attempt
testcases.objective: Verify duplicate creation does not modify the existing customer.

testcases.title: Retrieve existing customer using authorized user
testcases.objective: Verify authorized users can retrieve an existing customer.
steps: Send GET request using valid customerId.

testcases.title: Verify retrieval does not modify customer
testcases.objective: Verify GET operation is non-mutating.

testcases.title: Retrieve nonexistent customer
testcases.objective: Verify nonexistent customer returns not found without creating or modifying data.
steps: Send GET request using nonexistent customerId.
expected_result: No customer is created or modified.

testcases.title: Update existing customer using authorized user
testcases.objective: Verify an authorized user can update an existing customer.

testcases.title: Verify customer ID cannot be changed
testcases.objective: Verify update cannot change customerId.
steps: Attempt to update customer while supplying a different customerId.
expected_result: Original ID remains associated with customer.

testcases.title: Verify country validation during update
testcases.objective: Verify unsupported country cannot be introduced through update.

testcases.title: Verify update cannot create duplicate customer
testcases.objective: Verify an update that would produce an existing customerName and country combination is rejected.
steps: Attempt to update one customer to the name and country combination of another.

testcases.title: Update nonexistent customer
testcases.objective: Verify updating nonexistent customer does not create a customer.
steps: Send PUT request using nonexistent customerId.

testcases.title: Verify Manager authorization
testcases.objective: Verify Manager can create, retrieve and update customers.
expected_result: All operations produce expected functional results.

testcases.title: Verify Developer authorization
testcases.objective: Verify Developer can create and retrieve but cannot update customers.
expected_result: Update is rejected with authorization response.

testcases.title: Verify Business Head authorization
testcases.objective: Verify Business Head can create, retrieve and update customers.
preconditions: Valid Business Head credentials are available.
steps: Execute create, retrieve and update as Business Head.

testcases.title: Verify Business Lead authorization
testcases.objective: Verify Business Lead can create, retrieve and update customers.
preconditions: Valid Business Lead credentials are available.
steps: Execute create, retrieve and update as Business Lead.

testcases.title: Verify QA authorization
testcases.objective: Verify QA can create and retrieve but cannot update customers.

testcases.title: Reject unauthenticated access
testcases.objective: Verify unauthenticated users cannot access protected operations.
preconditions: No valid authentication token is provided.
expected_result: No customer data is created or modified.

testcases.title: Reject authenticated but unauthorized operation
testcases.objective: Verify authenticated users without required permission cannot perform restricted operations.
preconditions: User lacks permission for requested operation.

testcases.title: Verify unauthorized attempts are logged
testcases.objective: Verify unauthorized access attempts generate security evidence.

testcases.title: Verify invalid input does not modify data
testcases.objective: Verify invalid requests do not modify existing customer data.

testcases.title: Verify missing mandatory fields are handled
testcases.objective: Verify missing mandatory fields generate appropriate validation errors.

testcases.title: Verify invalid optional fields are rejected
testcases.objective: Verify invalid email and phone values are rejected.

testcases.title: Validate API response beyond HTTP status
testcases.objective: Verify successful API results are validated using status, structure, content and business outcome.
expected_result: A status code alone is not considered sufficient.

testcases.title: Verify API response time is below 8 seconds
testcases.objective: Verify API operations meet the response time requirement.
steps: Capture response time for each request.
Compare response time against eight-second threshold.
expected_result: Response time is less than 8 seconds under normal test conditions.
Any threshold breach is reported as a performance failure.

testcases.title: Execute security and penetration testing
testcases.objective: Verify security controls through authentication, authorization and applicable penetration checks.
expected_result: Unauthorized bypass is not accepted as a pass.

testcases.title: Verify security findings are preserved and escalated
testcases.objective: Verify security findings are retained and routed according to governance.

testcases.title: Verify execution evidence is preserved
testcases.objective: Verify every executed testcase produces traceable evidence.
steps: Collect request, response, status, timing and logs.
expected_result: Evidence is traceable to testcase and requirement.

testcases.title: Verify end-to-end traceability
testcases.objective: Verify requirement can be traced through testcase, data, automation, execution, evidence and result.
preconditions: RTM and testcase repository are available.

testcases.title: Verify requirement change triggers impact analysis and re-planning
testcases.objective: Verify the Agentic QE system identifies impacted testing when an approved requirement changes.
preconditions: Linked testcases, data and automation exist.
expected_result: Unaffected completed tests are not unnecessarily rerun.

testcases.title: Verify historical requirements and execution history are preserved
testcases.objective: Verify previous versions remain available after changes.
steps: Create or introduce new approved version.

testcases.title: Verify conflicting approved sources trigger human governance
testcases.objective: Verify the Agentic QE system detects and escalates conflicts between approved sources instead of guessing.
preconditions: A conflicting approved API specification states country is optional.
expected_result: Evidence from each source is preserved.
Agent does not silently select one source.

testcases.title: Verify approved testcase baseline cannot be changed without authorization
testcases.objective: Verify an agent cannot silently alter approved testcase definitions.
expected_result: Human approval is requested where required.

testcases.title: Verify artifacts are never deleted
testcases.objective: Verify the Agentic QE system never deletes existing artifacts.
steps: Request deletion of an existing artifact.
expected_result: Any obsolete artifact can only be marked or superseded.

testcases.title: Verify blocked testing is isolated while independent work continues
testcases.objective: Verify an environmental or dependency blockage does not unnecessarily stop independent testing.
preconditions: One execution dependency is intentionally unavailable.
expected_result: Blocked tests are not falsely marked failed or passed.
Execution report identifies blocked scope and impact.

testcases.title: Verify failures are validated before classification
testcases.objective: Verify the Agentic QE system validates observed failures against approved expected behavior before classifying them.
preconditions: A testcase produces an unexpected result.
steps: Compare observed result with approved expected result.
Check known defects and execution history.
expected_result: Observed failure is validated using evidence.
Failure is not classified solely from LLM interpretation.
Known issue, environment issue, data issue, requirement issue or product defect is distinguished where evidence supports it.
